author: InfiniteFutbol
body:
Ok so I got banned last year for lagging in the void and the mod that banned me  thought I was fly hacking, but I wasn't! Avic.us was the first server I ever played on and I loved the server. if you guys could pls acknowledge this that would be awesome. My IGN is InfiniteFutbol if you guys want to unban me which I hope you guys do
Thanks a lot, InfiniteFutbol :)
